taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.source_trace: Trace index/alias resolution and the actual security filter applied to the requested operation, including owned search/export paths.
controls.implementation_branch: Determine how multiple roles combine and whether document/field restrictions apply to the actual API and license/configuration. An alias is not inherently an authorization boundary. Compare search, direct document and alternate permitted paths with owned markers; an aggregation count or a metadata field can be a distinct limited disclosure rather than full document access.
controls.operational_method: Compute the effective same-index role combination: DLS grants combine by OR, and a role granting that index without DLS can remove the document restriction; field permissions combine by union. These read restrictions are not a general write policy. Retain every applicable role and index/alias match, then compare two synthetic documents/fields under the merged roles. A correct filtered search under one isolated role does not establish the actual user restriction.
controls.controlled_verification: Use synthetic documents for two owned tenants and compare an entitled query with a known foreign-document request through a relevant supported API.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An index name or intentionally shared aggregate is not a document leak; admin query success does not establish a user bypass.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind effective index/document policy across intended APIs and retest authorized searches and foreign markers.
